sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Two generations:

- **Bundlers** — webpack (config-heavy), Rollup (libraries), Parcel (zero-config).
- **Native ESM** — Vite (Rollup for prod, esbuild for dev), Turbopack (Next.js).

Pick by **dev speed** + **plugin ecosystem** + **prod output quality**.

- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **Tree-shaking** requires ES modules + side-effect-free code.
- **Code splitting** — dynamic `import()` is the universal API.
- **Source maps** — different modes (cheap / hidden / inline) for dev vs prod.
- **Module Federation** for micro-frontends — sharing chunks at runtime.
- **Lockfile** discipline — don't commit `node_modules`, do commit lockfile.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd default to Vite for new projects (dev speed), webpack for legacy + complex configs, split chunks via dynamic import, ensure tree-shaking with `sideEffects: false`, and analyse the bundle before optimising."*
